values.Owner1: China Petroleum West Pipeline Co Ltd

resolutions.researcher_notes: OWNER MISATTRIBUTION RISK -- WEST/EAST SECTION SPLIT. P4947 is staged as the FULL WEP2 trunk (worklist.json confirms StartLocation=Khorgas/Xinjiang through EndPrefecture/District=Guangzhou/Guangdong, 9102km), and the target Owner1 is 'China Petroleum West Pipeline Co Ltd' (中国石油天然气集团西部管道有限责任公司, since 2020 a PipeChina/国家管网集团 subsidiary: 国家管网集团西部管道有限责任公司) at 100%. Targeted search this pass found this company's own scope of operation is documented (company profile pages, investment disclosures) as the WESTERN section of WEP2 only -- Xinjiang Horgos through to the Ningxia Zhongwei hub, which it took over operating from 2009. The EASTERN section beyond Zhongwei -- which is where all five Jiangxi rows in this batch (P4793-P4797) and every other eastern branch sit -- was historically run by a separate entity, 中国石油西气东输管道(销售)有限公司 (West-East Gas Pipeline (Sales) Co), and PipeChina's own live 2025 Nanchang-branch coverage (https://www.shpgx.com/html/xyzx/20250326/7619.html) describes a distinct 西气东输公司南昌输气分公司 as the operating unit within Jiangxi today. I could not find a document that names 'China Petroleum West Pipeline Co Ltd' as owner of the eastern section or of the trunk as a whole -- if the west/east split is real, 100% to the West Pipeline company for a row spanning BOTH sections is geographically incomplete (it should either be split between two owner entities, or attributed to a different holding entity covering the whole trunk post-2020 restructuring, e.g. PipeChina/国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司 itself at the parent level). Leaving Owner UNRESOLVED rather than staging a value my own search casts doubt on; flagging for human adjudication rather than recommending a specific replacement, consistent with 'flag the delta, defer the recommendation.'
